title: crap-score entry measures
description: The list gates.crap-score.measures in docs/testing.yaml. crap-score runs the measures one after another, in list order. A measure without name, files, or command makes crap-score exit 2 and name the measure and the field (validation-rules.md BR-128, BR-129). An empty list or two measures with the same name also make it exit 2. files and exclude use one glob dialect: * matches within one path segment, and ** matches any number of segments (DEC-35).

name.description: The name of the measure, such as backend or python. gate-setup-proof --measure takes it, and the messages of crap-score name it.

files.description: A glob pattern relative to the repository root, such as packages/factory/scripts/*. crap-score judges only the rows whose file matches it (DEC-10). crap-score takes the pattern from the measure of the same name on the integration branch, and from the folder only for a measure that the branch does not name yet (validation-rules.md BR-128, DEC-75). * matches within one path segment, and ** matches any number of segments (DEC-35).

items.description: A glob pattern in the dialect of files (DEC-35).

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files that the gate never judges, such as **/db/alembic/versions/**. crap-score drops the rows whose file matches one of them (DEC-10). crap-score takes the list from the measure of the same name on the integration branch, and from the folder only for a measure that the branch does not name yet (validation-rules.md BR-128).

command.description: The measuring command, a project-owned script such as scripts/crap-measure-backend. It writes its rows to the path in GATE_OUTPUT, as measure-output-rows.json defines.

ready.description: The ready command, such as scripts/crap-ready-backend. It exits 0 when the measuring command can run now and any other code when it cannot. It measures nothing.
